name: Imperfect Volumes for Global Illumination
definition: A method for real-time computation of ambient occlusion (AO) and diffuse indirect light transport in fully dynamic scenes. It operates on a rough approximation of the entire scene created by a fast point-based voxelization algorithm, using 'imperfect volumes' where potential errors are small and do not produce objectionable errors in the final textured image.
summary: Imperfect Volumes is a real-time global illumination method that uses fast point-based voxelization to approximate lighting, trading geometric accuracy for speed and including off-screen geometry.
